attribution_quality.interpretation: A non-executable quality screen. Official daily release data can be delayed by publication schedule; those observations are regime context, not intraday evidence. News is scored only from timely, independently verified actuals; macro-vs-intraday divergence always demands WAIT. No claimed accuracy until an as-of, walk-forward XAU test is complete.
